description: This Python module provides functions for adding service-specific attributes to OpenTelemetry spans for various AI-related services, including TTS, STT, LLM, Gemini, and OpenAI. It defines methods to enrich tracing spans with contextual metadata, facilitating observability and debugging in a distributed system.
